children: Singapore Technologies Engineering's recent contract wins reinforce the company's potential to beat some of its 2029 targets, says RHB Research's Shekhar Jaiswal in a note. The defense engineering company won a 750 million Singapore dollar turnkey rail contract for a Taiwanese mass-rapid-transit line extension, around a month after a S$840 million win on another MRT line, the analyst notes. These contracts confirm the company's pipeline conversion and boost the revenue visibility of its urban solutions and satellite communications segment into the early-to-mid 2030s, he says. The contracts also ease concerns over softer 2Q order wins totaling S$2.9 billion, he adds. RHB retains its buy rating and S$12.70 target price. Shares drop 0.4% to S$10.36. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
